_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's kfserver settings were read as a reference only; pelican-eggs has no Killing Floor 1 egg). App 215360 isn't available to anonymous SteamCMD logins ("No subscription"), so the egg uses Octail's steam_login feature (required): the Steam account picked on the Startup tab logs in (it needn't own the game), Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console and the login is cached for start-time updates. The Linux depot (System/ucc-bin, 32-bit) is downloaded, SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times, the steamcmd download times out and retries, and the install fails when ucc-bin is missing. The 32-bit Steam libraries ucc-bin loads are copied into System/ at install and before every start (LinuxGSM's fix). System/KillingFloor.ini is made once from the shipped Default.ini; the ini parser sets the port, name, passwords, slots, difficulty, game length and WebAdmin before every start, and turns off the GameSpy uplink and LAN broadcast (dead or clashing between servers). WebAdmin is off by default on its own automatic port; the Unreal query port (main + 1) and the Steam query port (main + 21145, optional) are reserved with fixed_ports. The server reads no console input; start line "Game engine initialized" or the game port (UDP) bound; stop with Ctrl+C.
name: Killing Floor
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Killing Floor is a co-operative survival horror shooter by Tripwire Interactive: up to six players hold out against waves of Zeds, the clone specimens of Horzine Biotech, across London, buying weapons between waves.
startup: for octail_lib in steamclient.so libtier0_s.so libvstdlib_s.so; do [ ! -f "steamcmd/linux32/${octail_lib}" ] || cp -f "steamcmd/linux32/${octail_lib}" "System/${octail_lib}"; done; cd System && exec ./ucc-bin server "{{MAP}}?game=KFmod.KFGameType?VACSecured=true?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}" -nohomedir ini=KillingFloor.ini log=server.log

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Killing Floor dedicated server (Octail's own install script; LinuxGSM's kfserver settings were read as a reference
# only). App 215360 can't be downloaded anonymously ("No subscription"): the server needs a logged-in Steam account,
# which doesn't have to own Killing Floor. Octail's steam_login feature fills STEAM_USER and, for this install only,
# STEAM_PASS; Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console. The Linux build (System/ucc-bin, 32-bit).
set -uo pipefail

if [ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" ] || [ "${STEAM_USER}" = anonymous ]; then
    echo "The Killing Floor server can't be downloaded anonymously: pick a Steam account on the Startup tab"
    echo "(Steam account), then reinstall the server."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Logging in to Steam as ${STEAM_USER}"

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps # steamapps: SteamCMD's disk write error when it is missing
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz; then
    echo "Installation failed: SteamCMD couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

## the account's saved login (Tentacle's login cache), so later updates log in without the password
if [ -n "${STEAM_LOGIN_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/steamcmd/config && ln -s "${STEAM_LOGIN_CACHE}" /mnt/server/steamcmd/config
fi
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even running as root; the files are given to the server's user after the install.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

LOGIN=("${STEAM_USER}")
[ -n "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ] && LOGIN+=("${STEAM_PASS}")
[ -n "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" ] && LOGIN+=("${STEAM_AUTH}")

## install the server with steamcmd (the Linux depot)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${LOGIN[@]}" +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 and 64 bit Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/System/ucc-bin" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Killing Floor dedicated server. The download needs a logged-in Steam account;"
    echo "check the login lines above, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/System/ucc-bin

## the 32-bit Steam libraries ucc-bin loads from System/ (LinuxGSM's fix; the start line refreshes them after updates)
for LIB in steamclient.so libtier0_s.so libvstdlib_s.so; do
    [ -f "linux32/${LIB}" ] && cp -f "linux32/${LIB}" "/mnt/server/System/${LIB}"
done

## Octail: the server reads System/KillingFloor.ini, made once from the shipped Default.ini (a reinstall keeps yours).
## Octail sets the port, name, passwords, slots, difficulty, length and WebAdmin keys before every start.
cd /mnt/server/System || exit 1
if [ ! -f KillingFloor.ini ]; then
    if [ ! -f Default.ini ]; then
        echo "Installation failed: System/Default.ini is missing, so there is nothing to make KillingFloor.ini from."
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Writing System/KillingFloor.ini from Default.ini."
    cp Default.ini KillingFloor.ini
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as KF-BioticsLab.rom, KF-Farm.rom, KF-Manor.rom or KF-WestLondon.rom.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots (the game is made for 6).

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: 1 Beginner, 2 Normal, 4 Hard, 5 Suicidal, 7 Hell on Earth.

variables.name: Game Length
variables.description: 0 short (4 waves), 1 medium (7 waves), 2 long (10 waves); each ends with the Patriarch.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Players must enter it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: For adminlogin <password> in the game's console and the WebAdmin page (user admin). 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-.

variables.name: WebAdmin
variables.description: True turns on the WebAdmin page on the WebAdmin Port.

variables.name: WebAdmin Port
variables.description: The WebAdmin port (TCP). Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the dedicated server.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD (the saved login of the server's Steam account) before every start.
